subject: science
concept: Understanding cellular respiration as the process cells use to release energy from food
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Matter and Energy in Organisms) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models the inputs and outputs of cellular respiration using physical molecule tokens
exercise.pictorial: Student matches the cellular respiration word equation to a diagram of its inputs and outputs
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what cellular respiration does for a cell

misconception_flags: confuses cellular respiration's inputs and outputs with those of photosynthesis

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
